properties.note: Corn here — a field/forest edge on YOUR land on the bed→feed line (~9m off the bedding, right at the feed). Stages deer here before dark and pulls them off the neighbor strips. Check AL baiting law/season. Model-based; scout to confirm.

Stand ~25 yd past the corn toward the open, on the deer's travel line. Deer approach from the N (bedding). HUNT ONLY on a wind from about the S so your scent blows to the open, away from the bedding. Model-based; scout to confirm.
